title: 第9章 这是命令第10章 深度记忆
slug: 帝皇在上第699章兵临城下
lines: 二人停留在七八米开外。
他们小心翼翼的打量着罗德等人。
“你们是谁？”
“若想要停泊休整，请随我们进行海关登记，并缴纳停泊费用！”
大雨声让二人的声音变得有些模糊。
闻言，被护在亲卫们中间的罗德微微偏头。
而站在前边的菲利普蓦然抽出战剑。
裹挟着古铜战气的锋芒划出锐利的弧线。
这一剑仿佛要将身前的雨幕都给切下一块。
他竖持战剑，这是一种宣告的礼仪。
“通知代理人诺里斯·赫尔南德斯，他的领主来了。”
菲利普的语气冷峻，得到了罗德的示意。
初次见面，气势上绝对不能怂。
因为保不准黑滩镇的代理人会不会产生一些歪心思。
太过谦逊不仅无法彰显出权威，反而会刺激恶念的膨胀。
反之，不管那位代理人究竟有怎样的想法，其实罗德都做好了最坏的准备。
黑滩镇中心区域附近。
这里有着全镇最大的几幢宅子。
四周由花岗岩堆砌围墙。
附近还修筑了两座砖石塔楼。
其中最大的宅子就是原先的镇公馆。
在三日之前那里还是黑滩镇代理人诺里斯·赫尔南德斯的住所。
但在接到了消息后，他就很自觉的搬到了附近的另一幢屋子里。
此时夜色深重。
外边大雨倾盆，连空气都带上了一丝寒意。
但他所居住的屋子却暖意融融。
壁炉烧的很旺，富含油脂的松木在炉膛里劈啪作响
宽大的餐桌上杯盘狼藉。
大腹便便的诺里斯对面正趴着被灌醉的使者。
这位使者在三天前抵达黑滩镇。
他带来了拜伦·奥尔德林伯爵的亲笔信和通知函。
任谁也没想到，这鸟不拉屎的黑滩镇竟被伯爵分封给了次子罗德。
这让诺里斯的心情始终都不太好。
作为代理人，他才是镇内的实际统治者。
这里的生活对他来说并没有那么不堪。
虽然每年春季黑水海盗都会来取贡金，北山的蛮族也时常袭扰。
但这于他的生活无碍。
只是随着采邑领主的到来，他代理人的生活即将结束。

The two of them stayed seven or eight meters away.
They looked at Rhodes and others carefully.
"Who are you?"
“If you want to park for a rest, please register with us at customs and pay the parking fee!”
The sound of heavy rain made their voices somewhat muffled.
Hearing this, Rhodes, who was protected among the guards, tilted his head slightly.
And Phillip, who was standing in front, suddenly drew out his sword.
The edge wrapped with bronze fighting spirit drew a sharp arc.
This sword seemed to cut off a piece of the rain curtain in front of him.
He holds his sword upright as a sign of proclamation.
"Inform Agent Norris Hernandez that his lord has arrived."
Phillip's tone was cold, and he got a signal from Rhodes.
When meeting for the first time, you must not be timid in terms of momentum.
Because there is no guarantee that the agent in Black Beach Town will have some evil thoughts.
Too much humility will not only fail to demonstrate authority, but will stimulate the expansion of evil thoughts.
On the contrary, no matter what the agent's thoughts were, Rhodes was actually prepared for the worst.
…
Near the center of Black Beach Town.
Here are some of the largest houses in the town.
It is surrounded by granite walls.
Two masonry towers were also built nearby.
The largest house among them was the original town mansion.
Three days before it had been the residence of Norris Hernandez, attorney for the town of Black Beach.
But after receiving the news, he consciously moved to another house nearby.
It was dark at this time.
It was raining heavily outside, and even the air had a chill.
But the house he lived in was warm and cozy.
The fireplace burned brightly, and the greasy pine wood crackled in the hearth.
The large dining table was littered with cups and plates.
Opposite the potbellied Norris lay the drunken messenger.
The envoy arrived in Black Beach three days ago.
He brought with him a personal letter and notice from Lord Byron Aldrin.
No one expected that the lifeless Black Beach Town would be entrusted to the second son Rhodes by the earl.
This made Norris always feel bad.
As agent, he is the actual ruler of the town.
Life here is not that bad for him.
Although the Blackwater pirates come every spring to collect tribute, the barbarians from Beishan also often attack.
But it doesn't affect his life.
It was only with the arrival of the fief lord that his life as an agent was coming to an end.
